title: ETHIO-NASA: Orbital Defense
description: Build original spacecraft, fly approximate RK4/J2 orbital missions, and explore astronaut EVA and lunar rover operations in a Three.js spaceflight simulator by MG Studio.

defaultCaptions.x: ETHIO-NASA: Orbital Defense — design spacecraft, fly orbital missions, and explore lunar surface operations. An original spaceflight simulator by MG Studio.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Build a spacecraft, navigate orbit, and take an astronaut EVA or lunar rover into the field in ETHIO-NASA: Orbital Defense.
defaultCaptions.reddit: An original Three.js spacecraft-building and orbital flight simulator with EVA and lunar rover gameplay.
defaultCaptions.discord: ETHIO-NASA: Orbital Defense — an original spacecraft construction, orbital flight, EVA and lunar survey game.
